name: Orange Police Department Teen Academy
what_you_do: Spend four mornings behind the scenes at the Orange Police Department. Officers mentor you and show you how the department works.
who_can_apply: Teens 14 to 18 who live or go to school in the city of Orange. You must come to all 4 sessions.
pay_detail: The program page does not list a cost or pay.
deadline_text: The 2026 class ran June 22 to 25, 2026. Applications are closed. Dates for 2027 are not posted.
how_to_apply: Check the program page for a new form. The 2026 form is closed.
notes: These are last year's dates. The 2027 dates are not posted yet. The page does not say when applications open. Classes were at the Orange Police Department.
